title: WorkerResult
description: The structured terminal return from an ephemeral worker, delivered to the manager as an InboxItem of kind 'delegation_result'. Exactly one terminal result is delivered per delegated Task (ADR 0007, ADR 0012). A result failing this schema is recorded as status 'failed' with the raw output preserved as an artifact.

task_id.description: The delegated Task whose lifecycle this result terminates.

result.description: Structured result content per the task's expected_output and delegation output_contract.

summary.description: Concise human/manager-readable summary; required even on failure.

artifacts.description: Artifact ids produced by the worker.

evidence.description: References supporting the result (event ids, artifact ids, external refs).

proposed_learnings.description: Memory proposals in the standard shape so the manager can accept them without translation.
